evidence_quotes: The board shall set forth the employer contribution to the health insurance premium for each retiree class. For employees who retire other than for disability after September 30, 2005, they will be subject to a sliding scale premium calculation.

Effective October 1, 2010, the amount of the employer contribution to cover the cost of a retiree who is not covered by Medicare and who retires after September 30, 2010, shall not exceed the amount of the employer contribution to cover the cost of an active employee.
